title: Elph settings configuration
description: User preferences for the Elph coding agent. Active model, thinking level, and agent mode are per-session (not stored here). Home: CONFIG_DIR/settings.json. Project: <workDir>/.elph/settings.json. Merge: defaults ← home ← project always (project wins per nested key; arrays replace). MCP cache is in mcp.json; project-extension trust is in trust.json. Runtime saves write the home layer only. Unknown keys are ignored.

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL (editor autocompletion). Ignored at runtime.

preferredChatLanguage.description: Preferred language for AI chat responses in the transcript. Code, comments, and documentation remain in English.

simplifiedTechnicalEnglish.description: Follow Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100) in every response: short active sentences, plain words without jargon or hedging, one consistent term per concept, and no preamble/recap/closing pleasantries. Applies to chat replies and content written to files; non-English prose keeps the style rules (the controlled vocabulary applies to English prose). Set false to fall back to the plain style rules.

maxRetries.description: Retries on 5xx / network errors for LLM HTTP transport.

defaultTimeout.description: Inactivity and SSE stall limit for LLM streams (e.g. 120s, 2m, 1h, or milliseconds as digits).

defaultTools.description: Built-in tool allowlist. null/omitted = all builtins. [] = none (list_available_tools and list_skills stay). MCP and WASM tools are not filtered.

shellPath.description: Custom shell binary. Leading ~ is expanded.

shellCommandPrefix.description: Prefix prepended to every shell_exec command.

httpProxy.description: HTTP proxy URL applied as HTTP_PROXY and HTTPS_PROXY when those env vars are unset.

quietStartup.description: Hide bootstrap spinner / startup chatter. ELPH_QUIET still wins when set.

theme.description: Appearance: auto follows terminal via COLORFGBG; dark/light force a base palette.

themes.description: Optional per-appearance color token overrides (partial maps).

showThinking.description: Stream model reasoning / thinking blocks in the TUI.

autoExpandThinking.description: When true, thinking blocks start expanded in the transcript.

stickyScroll.description: Pin the latest user prompt while scrolling assistant replies.

footerTokenDisplay.description: How context token usage is shown in the status footer.

coloredStatusFooter.description: When true, footer status uses mode/thinking/git accent colors; otherwise dimmed grey.

density.description: Transcript log density: compact (default) packs collapsed tool call items into a grouped log (no blank line between them). Expanded (accessed) tool call items, Thinking, and AI chat response/assistant items always keep line breaks above and below. Loose keeps a blank line between every process-log row.

showHiddenFiles.description: When true, @ file search includes dotfiles and dot-directories.

allowModeChangeWhileBusy.description: When true, allow mode changes (keyboard shortcut and agent request) while the agent is busy streaming or running tools.

turnStats.description: When true (default), show a dimmed per-turn stats card under the last assistant reply after each completed turn: duration, tokens in/out, cached tokens (when reported), and provider/model.

themePalettes.description: Dark and light token maps. Each map is a partial UiTheme color override.

themeTokens.description: Partial color overrides. Values: #RGB/#RRGGBB, rgb(r,g,b), 'r,g,b', or named colors (white, reset, …).

colorValue.description: iocraft Color as hex (#RRGGBB), rgb()/rgba(), r,g,b CSV, named color, [r,g,b], or {r,g,b}.

models.description: Model catalog preferences and seeds for new sessions (not live session state).

defaultModel.description: Optional provider/model_id seed for new sessions only (e.g. openai/gpt-5.6-luna). null/absent → no model until picked. Live model is per-session.

sessionTitleModel.description: Model for session title generation. Use provider/model_id or "inherit" for the session model.

compactionModel.description: Model used when summarizing history during compaction. "inherit" uses the session model.

treeBranchSummaries.description: Model for tree branch summarization. "inherit" uses the session model.

defaultThinkingLevel.description: Thinking/reasoning level seed for new sessions only. Live level is per-session.

showConfiguredOnly.description: When true, the model picker All list and Provider tabs only show providers with credentials in auth.json.

scopedModels.description: Models for Ctrl+P cycling and the Scoped tab. Edit via /scoped-models.

enabled.description: Glob filter for the model catalog (provider/model_id or bare id). Supports * wildcards, !exclude, +exact, -exact. Empty = no filter.

thinkingBudgets.description: Custom thinking token budgets per level.

embedModel.description: Local embedding model id (catalog name or Hugging Face repo).

embedQuantized.description: Prefer quantized ONNX weights when a *Q variant exists.

embedGpuAcceleration.description: GPU acceleration: on, off, or auto. Device selection is compile-time (metal/cuda features).

oneOf.description: Optional TOON prompt encoding for model-visible tool results. Absent/null falls back to ELPH_PROMPT_ENCODING* env vars.

mode.description: When to apply TOON encoding: off (never), toon (all eligible structured payloads), auto (uniform tabular arrays only). Unknown values fall back to off.

minBytes.description: Minimum JSON byte length before TOON encoding applies.

minSavingsRatio.description: Encode only when the TOON form is at most this ratio of the JSON size (1.0 = strictly smaller).

tabularDelimiter.description: TOON delimiter for tabular arrays (default: tab).

targets.description: Which tool-result surfaces TOON may rewrite (both default to true).

preamble.description: Preamble above TOON fenced blocks. Defaults to the built-in TOON hint.

memory.description: Floppy project memory hooks and retrieval. Embedding model is models.embedModel.

enabled.description: Master switch for automatic memory hooks and bootstrap injection. Agent tools can still open the store when disabled.

autoCaptureWork.description: Auto-journal successful file mutations as work/change memories.

autoCaptureExploration.description: Auto-capture exploration into discovery / project-map memories.

topK.description: Vector top-k for task retrieval (active recall pulls up to this many semantic hits).

contextBudgetChars.description: Max characters for all injected memory XML blocks.

minQueryLength.description: Minimum user prompt length to trigger auto-recall. Task-like short prompts still recall.

notifications.description: Desktop notification preferences. Controls which events trigger native OS notifications (macOS Notification Center, Linux D-Bus, Windows Toast).

enabled.description: Master switch — disable all desktop notifications.

onTurnComplete.description: Notify when the agent finishes a turn.

onToolPermission.description: Notify when the agent requests tool permission.

onUserQuestion.description: Notify when the agent asks a question.

onError.description: Notify on errors (agent / MCP / bootstrap failure).

onTurnCancel.description: Notify when a running turn is canceled.

minTurnDurationSecs.description: Minimum turn duration (seconds) before sending a turn-complete notification. Prevents noise from quick turns.

appName.description: Application name shown in the notification banner.

compaction.description: Auto-compaction thresholds. Automatic compaction always runs after turns when usage exceeds the threshold; manual /compact is always available. There is no enabled kill-switch.

thresholdPct.description: Context-window usage percentage (1–100) that triggers compaction. Compact when context tokens exceed contextWindow * thresholdPct / 100.

keepRecentTokens.description: Number of recent tokens to retain after compaction.

physicalPrune.description: Physically DELETE pre-boundary session_entries after compact.

reserveTokens.description: Tokens reserved for the model response during compaction.

session.description: Session storage and retention (not live model/mode state).

resources.description: Extra paths and filters for skills, prompts, and WASM extensions.

disabledSkills.description: Skill names (globs) to drop after discovery.

enableSkillCommands.description: Register discovered skills as /name slash commands.
